item.title: JINHEZO Mini Waterproof LED Tea Lights Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries; Imported by Mystic ZO
item.company: Online at Amazon.com from March 2024 through July 2026 for between $16 to $20 per pack.
item.brand: Online at Amazon.com from March 2024 through July 2026 for between $16 to $20 per pack.
item.product: JINHEZO Mini Waterproof LED Tea Lights
item.summary: This recall involves JINHEZO Mini Waterproof LED Tea Lights. The circular tea lights are clear with a white base and are about 1" in diameter and 1.14" tall. They come in a pack of 24 lights with 48 coin-cell batteries (two per light).
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: JINHEZO Mini Waterproof LED Tea Lights.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled LED Tea Lights immediately and contact Mystic Zo for a full refund. To receive a refund, consumers will be asked to email their order number or bar code number, if available, along with a photo of the tea lights disposed of in the trash to jinhemaoyi2016@sina.com. Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
